Jack

A talking jack-o'-lantern for your projector.

  1. Plug your laptop into the projector and point the webcam at where people will stand.
  2. Click Wake Jack and choose Allow for the camera and microphone.
  3. Press F for full screen and H to hide the control panel.
Space or joystick trigger: talk (hold)
Left/Right or left stick: look left and right
Up/Down or right stick: step closer or farther away
B or joystick button 2: boo!
1 or 2 pick a voice   V next voice   K next character   M crowd or copy-my-face
T push-to-talk on or off   C center your face (copy-my-face mode)   F full screen
H hide panel   P bigger crowd view
